semiconductor_relevance: High — JX Metals Trading provides essential metal materials and plating chemicals specifically designed for semiconductor applications.
summary: JX Metals Trading is a key supplier of metal materials and plating chemicals crucial for semiconductor manufacturing. The company focuses on rare metals and offers comprehensive services including material supply and component processing, with an emphasis on timely chemical development and analysis. They are also expanding into environmental protection and functional chemicals to enhance resource efficiency and recycling.
capabilities: Supply of rare metal materials for electronic components
Manufacture of plating chemicals for semiconductors
Development of environmental protection and functional chemicals
